name: Rakuten ~Kono Yo no Rakuen? Ano yo no Tengoku!?~
original_name: らくてん～この世の楽園？あの世の天国!?～
source:
Main character is a mediocre student. One day he gets into a traffic accident and regains consciousness in the body of an outstanding student and sportsman who was in the same accident. There are plenty of passionate girls around, and many of them don't mind giving their first time to him...

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/06/vn-of-month-november-2007-demon.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角是一名成绩平平的学生。有一天，他遭遇了一场交通事故，在一名同样遭遇车祸的优秀学生兼运动员的身体里苏醒。身边热情的女孩很多，很多都不介意把第一次给他……

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/06/vn-of-month-november-2007-demon.html]vndbreview[/url]]
